name: API Platform
description: API Platform is a full-stack framework built on Symfony for rapidly creating REST and GraphQL APIs with automatic OpenAPI documentation and schema generation. Created by Les-Tilleuls.coop in France, it supports JSON-LD, Hydra, and JSON:API standards.

owner.name: Les-Tilleuls.coop
owner.description: French worker cooperative specializing in open-source web development and API technologies.
